LightningComponentBundle.description: Runs active upload processes available to the current user.

property.name: componentLabel
property.label: Component Heading
property.description: Visible heading that distinguishes this configured component instance.

property.name: processSelectionMode
property.label: Processes to Show
property.description: Show one selected process, a configured group of processes, or every active process compatible with this record's object.

property.name: selectedProcessDeveloperName
property.label: Selected Process
property.description: Used when Processes to Show is SELECTED_PROCESS.

property.name: bundleDeveloperName
property.label: Upload Bundle
property.description: Used when Processes to Show is CONFIGURED_PROCESSES.
